preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 10,000.
The number of vertices in each tree is between 2 and 200,000.
Vertices are numbered from 1 to n and are distinct.

preconditions.expression: The sum of n over all test cases does not exceed 2 * 10^5.
preconditions.description: The total number of vertices across all test cases is at most 200,000.

postconditions.expression: The output is a single integer for each test case.
postconditions.description: Each output must represent the minimum number of leaves that can be achieved after performing the described operations.

invariants.expression: The input graph is a tree.
invariants.description: Each test case provides a rooted tree with no cycles and exactly n-1 edges.
